Remark
[No initial-time curvature bound is needed] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0290 ↗ thm:chow-ii-hamilton-matrix-harnack 1. ch15:15.2\group Matrix Harnack Estimates

The conclusion of Theorem 2 remains valid for a flow on $(0,T)$ whose curvature is bounded on every compact time interval, even if $\sup _{\mathcal M}|\Rm (t)|\to \infty $ as $t\downarrow 0$.
Proof

\sketch Apply the theorem on $[\varepsilon ,T')$, with time translated by $t\mapsto t-\varepsilon $. For fixed $t>0$, let $\varepsilon \downarrow 0$; the additional Ricci term is $R_{ij}/(2(t-\varepsilon ))$, which converges to $R_{ij}/(2t)$. Then let $T'\uparrow T$.

□
